column7: the pre-existing test for #2855's property, strengthened. It was already NAMED RevokesSessionAndPAT and its doc comment already claimed "unable to authenticate via ANY credential", but it only asserted that ValidatePATToken returns an ERROR -- which it does regardless, because a deprovisioned account is login-blocked and soft-deleted. So it proved INERTNESS while its name promised REVOCATION, and passed identically with the revoke call absent. That is exactly how the gap survived review. It now also asserts the ROW state (no unrevoked PAT remains), which is the assertion that could have caught it. Red on pristine origin/main. Recorded as its own claim because "a green test named for the property" is the failure mode worth having in the ledger, not just the missing call
